entries.302279d3da70debb: A company that sells shoes as a specialty shoe store chain with 863 stores nationwide and an official online shop.
entries.3c5693763617edc1: The consolidated subsidiary Tomoe Shoji Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale of shoes and sells products to the company. In May 2025, it acquired the business of Ōkuni Japan Co., Ltd.
entries.59b4af0f1ddce15b: The company engages in shoe retail through its stores under the names Shūpuraza Chiyoda, Tōkyō Kutsu Ryūtsū Sentā and Shūzu Paretta, and its official online shop "kutsu.com". The number of stores at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year was 863.
entries.7895dd3d5b681cc5: The consolidated subsidiary Chiyoda Bussan Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale of shoes and sells products to the company.
entries.96b92197998eceec: Retail and wholesale of shoes. Net sales for the fiscal year ended February 2026 were ¥81,377 million.
